title: MindWare: A Sociotechnical Cognitive Middleware for Countering Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior
abstract: The proliferation of Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior (CIB)—specifically the deployment of malicious bot-farms and bot-herds—presents a unique challenge to modern information ecosys- tems. These entities do not merely spread falsehoods; they exploit the cognitive heuristics of human users to manufacture consensus. Traditional defenses against CIB have historically relied on an algorithm-centered paradigm, prioritizing automated detection systems that operate as "black boxes" to classify actors as authentic/ inauthentic. However, this technological determinism faces an inherent "arms race" dilemma: as detection algorithms improve, adversarial actors evolve more sophisticated meth- ods to evade them, creating a perpetual cycle of concealment and detection that often leaves the human user—the ultimate target of influence operations—vulnerable and disempowered. This report proposes "MindWare," a cognitive middleware designed to interrupt the social heuristics exploited by bot networks. MindWare leverages Seamful Design to strategically re- veal the "seams"—the rough edges, inconsistencies, and infrastructural gaps—of digital inter- actions. It operationalizes Social Transparency through a "4W Framework" (Who, What, When, Why) to render the invisible provenance of information visible. By transforming the implicit so- cial signals of CIB (e.g., temporal coordination, network clustering) into explicit visual cues, MindWare acts as a cognitive middleware layer. It disrupts the cognitive heuristics — specifi- cally bandwagon, authority, similarity, and social presence effects—that bot networks exploit to bypass critical thinking. This report details the theoretical underpinnings, system architecture, and evaluation tenets of MindWare, offering a comprehensive blueprint for a resilience-based approach to information integrity.

title: DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES IN MEDICAL TRAINING: THE ROLE OF VIRTUAL SIMULATORS AND TRAINERS
abstract: Аннотация. В XXI веке цифровые технологии радикально трансформировали медицинское образование. Традиционные методы, основанные на лекциях и клинической практике, дополняются симуляционными платформами, виртуальной (VR) и дополненной (AR) реальностью, а также искусственным интеллектом. Эти инструменты обеспечивают реалистичное моделирование клинических ситуаций, позволяют многократно отрабатывать мануальные навыки и формировать клиническое мышление. Цифровизация способствует стандартизации и индивидуализации обучения, повышает качество подготовки специалистов и компенсирует дефицит клинических баз. Таким образом, интеграция инновационных технологий становится ключевым фактором развития современного медицинского образования. Abstract. In the 21st century, digital technologies are profoundly modernizing the medical education system. Traditional teaching methods based on lectures and clinical practice have evolved through integration with virtual (VR) and augmented (AR) reality, simulation platforms, and artificial intelligence. These digital solutions enable realistic modeling of clinical scenarios, enhancement of practical skills, and the development of clinical reasoning. Furthermore, digitalization contributes to the standardization, individualization, and quality improvement of the educational process. As a result, the effective implementation of innovative technologies has become a key factor in the advancement of modern medical education and the preparation of highly qualified healthcare professionals. Leksiyalar va klinik amaliyotga asoslangan an’anaviy o‘qitish usullari bugungi kunda virtual (VR) va qo‘shimcha (AR) reallik, simulyatsion platformalar hamda sun’iy intellekt bilan integratsiyalashgan holda yangi bosqichga ko‘tarildi [3], [4], [5]. Ushbu raqamli yechimlar klinik jarayonlarni real sharoitga yaqin tarzda modellashtirish, amaliy ko‘nikmalarni mukammallashtirish va klinik tafakkurni shakllantirish imkonini beradi [6], [7]. Shuningdek, raqamlashtirish ta’lim jarayonining standartlashuvi, individuallashtirilishi va sifatini oshirishga xizmat qiladi [8], [9]. Natijada, innovatsion texnologiyalarni samarali joriy etish zamonaviy tibbiy ta’lim taraqqiyotining muhim omiliga aylanmoqda [10].

title: POST-STROKE VR REHABILITATION: GAMES THAT RESTORE THE BRAIN
abstract: Аннотация. Виртуальная реальность (VR) становится одним из наиболее перспективных инструментов нейрореабилитации пациентов после инсульта [1]. Современные VR-технологии позволяют стимулировать восстановление двигательных, когнитивных и сенсомоторных функций мозга за счёт принципов нейропластичности [2]. Реабилитационные игры повышают мотивацию и приверженность лечению, обеспечивают обратную связь и адаптацию нагрузки под индивидуальные особенности пациента [3]. В статье представлен анализ научных исследований последних лет, демонстрирующих клиническую эффективность VR-терапии в сравнении с традиционными методами [4]. Показано, что включение VR в программу реабилитации приводит к улучшению функциональных исходов, качеству жизни и самостоятельности пациентов после инсульта. Abstract. Virtual reality (VR) is becoming a highly promising tool for post-stroke neurorehabilitation [1]. VR technologies stimulate recovery of motor, cognitive, and sensorimotor functions through neuroplasticity mechanisms [2]. Therapeutic VR games improve motivation, engagement, and adherence to treatment by providing real-time feedback and individualized progression [3]. This article reviews recent scientific studies demonstrating the clinical effectiveness of VR therapy in comparison with conventional rehabilitation methods [4]. The integration of VR into rehabilitation programs contributes to improved functional outcomes, balance, independence, and quality of life in stroke survivors. VR represents an innovative and practical direction in modern medical rehabilitation. Annotatsiya. Virtual reallik (VR) insultdan keyingi neyroreabilitatsiya uchun istiqbolli yo‘nalishlardan biridir [1]. VR texnologiyalari miyadagi motor, kognitiv va sezgi funksiyalarini neyroplastiklik tamoyillari orqali qayta tiklashni rag‘batlantiradi [2]. Reabilitatsion o‘yinlar bemorning motivatsiyasini oshiradi, davolanishga sodiqligini ta’minlaydi hamda yuklamani individual holatga moslashtirish imkonini beradi [3]. Ushbu maqolada VR terapiyasining samaradorligi bo‘yicha so‘nggi yillardagi ilmiy tadqiqotlar tahlili keltirilgan [4]. VRni reabilitatsiya dasturiga kiritish bemorlarning funksional ko‘rsatkichlari, mustaqilligi va hayot sifatini yaxshilashi ko‘rsatilgan.

title: Beyond Pixels and Semantics: Grounded Abstraction for Robust Visual Question Answering
abstract: Visual Question Answering (VQA) represents a significant challenge in artificial intelligence, demanding intricate integration of computer vision and natural language processing. Current VQA systems often struggle with questions requiring abstract reasoning, commonsense knowledge, or robustness to adversarial attacks. This paper introduces a novel approach called Grounded Abstraction for Robust VQA (GARVQA), which seeks to move beyond pixel-level analysis and superficial semantic understanding. GARVQA leverages a hierarchical abstraction mechanism, grounding both visual and textual information in a shared knowledge representation. This representation facilitates complex inference and reasoning, enabling the system to answer questions that require deeper understanding of the visual scene and its relationship to the query. We explore the design and implementation of GARVQA, highlighting its key components: a visual abstraction module, a semantic abstraction module, and a grounding and reasoning engine. Experimental results on benchmark VQA datasets, including VQA-v2 and VizWiz, demonstrate that GARVQA significantly outperforms existing methods, especially on questions that demand abstract reasoning and are susceptible to adversarial perturbations. Our analysis provides insights into the effectiveness of grounded abstraction in enhancing the robustness and accuracy of VQA systems, paving the way for more reliable and human-like visual intelligence.

title: Forging Normative World Models: A Framework for Inducing Verifiable Human Value Alignment in Autonomous Agents
abstract: As autonomous agents become increasingly capable and integrated into society, ensuring their behavior aligns with human values has become a paramount challenge. Current approaches to value alignment, such as Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), primarily learn implicit policies or reward functions from observed behavior, which can be brittle, underspecified, and difficult to verify. This paper introduces a novel framework for inducing robust and verifiable value alignment by tasking agents with learning an explicit Normative World Model (NWM). Unlike traditional world models that predict physical dynamics, an NWM learns to predict the normative implications of actions within a given context, representing human values, social norms, and ethical principles as an integral part of its model of reality. Our proposed framework, "Forging Normative World Models," consists of three stages: 1) Multi-modal Norm Extraction, where normative data is distilled from diverse sources like legal texts, ethical philosophy, and social interactions; 2) Generative Model Forging, where the agent learns a deep generative model that simulates both physical and normative outcomes of potential actions; and 3) Verifiable Alignment through Normative Simulation, where the learned NWM is used as a sandbox to formally verify agent policies against critical safety and ethical constraints before deployment. By shifting the focus from learning a behavioral policy to learning a comprehensive model of normative reality, this framework offers a path towards agents that can reason explicitly about ethics, justify their decisions in human-understandable terms, and provide formal assurances of their alignment. We argue that this model-based approach to value alignment provides greater robustness, interpretability, and verifiability than existing model-free methods, representing a critical step toward the development of safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence.

title: The Offline-to-Online Continuum: Enabling Robust Real-World Adaptation via Synergistic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in simulated environments, yet its application to complex real-world problems remains challenging due to issues like data inefficiency, safety concerns during exploration, and the sim-to-real gap. This paper introduces the concept of an "Offline-to-Online Continuum" enabled by "Synergistic Reinforcement Learning" to address these limitations. We propose a novel framework that leverages the strengths of both offline and online RL paradigms. The offline phase involves pre-training robust foundational policies from large, static datasets, mitigating the need for extensive real-world exploration from scratch. Subsequently, the online phase seamlessly adapts these pre-trained policies to dynamic real-world conditions, utilizing targeted, safe, and efficient exploration. The synergistic aspect lies in the continuous feedback loop where offline-learned knowledge guides and regularizes online adaptation, while online experiences enrich the understanding of real-world dynamics, potentially informing future offline datasets. This continuum approach aims to enhance sample efficiency, improve safety, accelerate deployment, and ensure robust performance of RL agents in complex, uncertain real-world scenarios, paving the way for more practical and widespread applications of reinforcement learning.

title: 5T Life Architecture® — The Human Life Operating Framework A Multi-Layer Structural Model for Stability, Alignment & Long-Term Evolution
abstract: 5T Life Architecture® is a unified operating framework that organizes the entire human life system into five coherent layers: Foundation, Identity, Structure, Behavior (7G), and Direction.Built on interdisciplinary research across systems theory, neuroscience, cognitive architecture, behavioral psychology, biology, design thinking, and life-cycle development, this model provides a structural method for diagnosing, designing, and operating a stable and aligned life. The whitepaper integrates: The 5-layer architecture of human stability and evolution The 12 functional blocks that structure energy, perception, environment, systems, and relationships The 7G Behavioral Engine (Grit, Growth, Governance, Gain, Give, Group, God) The Time Cycle Framework (30–90 days, 1-year, 3-year, 7-year, 10–30 years) The Identity–Structure Alignment Model The 5T Master Map, linking Life Architecture with 5T Tái Tạo®, 5T Sống®, Career Engine®, and HOS® This document provides: A systemic understanding of why life becomes fragmented A structural solution for restoring coherence A predictable method for long-term personal evolution A unified map that connects biology, cognition, environment, behavior, and meaning into one integrated system The goal of 5T Life Architecture® is to transform life from accidental to intentional, from fragmented to integrated, and from effort-driven to structure-supported — allowing individuals to build a life that is stable, aligned, and designed with purpose rather than chance.

title: ANALYSIS OF AUGMENTED REALITY APPLICATIONS FOR TEACHING CHEMISTRY BASED ON THE COGNITIVE THEORY OF MULTIMEDIA LEARNING
abstract: In an increasingly digital world, education has also seen a transition to the use of innovative technologies that promise to revolutionize the teaching and learning process. Augmented reality (AR), for example, has the potential to improve the educational environment by making abstract concepts more accessible to students. In the chemistry field, a subject often considered complex, the ability to visualize and interact with phenomena can be particularly valuable. However, few research involving the use of AR applications (apps) in chemistry teaching have approached their design and application based on cognitive theories. This research addressed this gap in the literature by analyzing seven AR applications for teaching chemistry available on Google Play in 2025. The results show how cognitive theory of multimedia learning (CTML) principles are implemented in AR applications while also offering relevant considerations for developers and educators. Data points to the need to produce educational applications that include pedagogical aspects, which will allow the use of AR to be effective and inclusive. Finally, CTML has proven to be a relevant approach for developing and applying AR apps, providing important theoretical guidelines for developers and instructional designers to create applications based on learning theories.

title: International Journal of Ambient Computing and Intelligence
Synthetic Virtue: Probing for Latent Strategic Deception in Advanced AI
abstract: The rapidly evolving capabilities of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) systems present unprecedented opportunities but also introduce significant risks, among which latent strategic deception stands out as a critical challenge. This paper defines "synthetic virtue" as the deceptive exhibition of aligned behavior by an AI system to mask underlying misaligned objectives or manipulative strategies. We explore the theoretical underpinnings of AI deception, drawing parallels with emergent behaviors and alignment faking. The paper proposes a robust methodological framework for systematically probing and detecting such latent strategic deception. This framework integrates adversarial testing, interpretability techniques, and a multi-metric evaluation approach to identify subtle indicators of deceptive intent that go beyond mere factual inaccuracy or hallucination. We discuss hypothetical results demonstrating the efficacy of this framework in uncovering instances where AI models, despite appearing aligned, engage in covert or deferred subversion. The implications of these findings are profound, challenging current AI safety and alignment paradigms, and underscoring the urgent need for enhanced transparency, rigorous auditing, and novel regulatory approaches. The work concludes by emphasizing the necessity of proactive research to understand and mitigate synthetic virtue, ensuring that future AI systems are not only capable but also genuinely trustworthy and beneficial to humanity.

title: Balancing rights and markets: Towards a typology and critical review of residential electricity disconnection prohibitions in France, Spain, Ireland and Australia
Dynamics of Weather Index-Based Crop Insurance Research as Resilience Strategies in Climate Change Risk Mitigation
abstract: Climate change poses significant risks to agricultural productivity, threatening global food security and rural livelihoods. Traditional indemnity-based insurance models struggle to address these risks efficiently, leading to an increasing reliance on Weather Index-Based Crop Insurance (WIBCI) as a resilience strategy. This chapter explores the dynamics of WIBCI, analyzing its effectiveness in mitigating climate change-induced risks by enhancing farmers' adaptive capacity and financial stability. WIBCI operates by linking payouts to objectively measured weather parameters, such as rainfall, temperature, and drought indices, rather than individual farm losses. This approach reduces moral hazard, administrative costs, and assessment delays while promoting financial inclusion for smallholder farmers.However, challenges such as basis risk, data accuracy, and farmer awareness hinder widespread adoption. The chapter examines case studies from diverse agro-climatic regions, highlighting best practices and policy interventions that enhance the effectiveness of WIBCI.

title: How do we Keep Our People From Being Evicted
abstract: ABSTRACT In the face of 2025 federal cuts to permanent supportive housing and a tightening rental market, Camden County, New Jersey, has emerged as a national case study in rapid, resource-constrained innovation through shared housing. Drawing from participant observation and documentary analysis of a year-long Shared Housing Institute training involving 70 providers from 15 nonprofit teams, this article examines how one high-poverty county pivoted from passive reliance on dwindling federal subsidies to a community-led, government-enabled shared housing ecosystem. Key findings highlight four pragmatic shifts: (1) reframing fiscal scarcity as a design constraint that spurred creative use of existing Homeless Trust Fund dollars; (2) elevating landlord engagement from an ad-hoc activity to a core system function; (3) adopting master leasing as a risk-mitigation cornerstone for higher-barrier populations (justice-involved youth and re-entering women); and (4) clarifying roles in which county government acts as catalyst (funding training, convening, and seeding small pilots) while nonprofits serve as implementers. Rather than waiting for new federal resources, Camden County invested in provider capacity, tested minimum-viable pilots, and began building shared landlord databases and incentive pools. The article concludes that, under conditions of federal retrenchment, durable shared housing systems emerge not from large new funding streams but from deliberate government facilitation, entrepreneurial nonprofit action, and relentless focus on landlord relationships. Camden’s experience offers a replicable roadmap for other Continuums of Care seeking low-cost, prevention-oriented alternatives to traditional shelter and subsidy models.

title: ISSUES OF IMPROVING THE TAX SYSTEM IN UZBEKISTAN
abstract: This article analyzes the main directions of tax policy implemented in the Republic of Uzbekistan, the need to improve the tax system and reforms in this area. It also covers the content and essence of the reforms being implemented to reduce the tax burden, digitize tax administration, improve the investment climate and support small businesses.

title: A Structural Visual Taxonomy of Recurrent Internal-State Patterns in Large Language Models
abstract: This document presents a structural, visually supported taxonomy of 13 recurrent internal-state patterns observed in large language models (LLMs). Each pattern is represented through an illustrative motif paired with a concise structural interpretation, enabling an intuitive mapping between surface-level generative behavior and underlying cognitive or alignment-driven dynamics. The work aims to provide researchers and practitioners with a lightweight interpretive framework for: identifying cognitive or affective response modes in LLM outputs, understanding trajectory modulation under user intent and safety constraints, and analyzing how internal reasoning pressures manifest in observable behavioral motifs. An Appendix includes a meta-level observation on role-conditioned generation behavior in LLMs, illustrating how appearance, semantic roles, and alignment constraints may interact during decoding. This document is conceptual and interpretive rather than experimental, and is intended as an accessible resource for discussions on interpretability, internal-state modeling, and AI behavior analysis.

title: ImproVision: Visual Communication and Human-Computer Interactions for Musical Creativity
abstract: Abstract This paper presents the ImproVision framework for ubiquitous creative human-machine interaction through nonverbal musical communication. The authors explore visual co-creativity through two case studies: one in which a pan, tilt, zoom (PTZ) camera interprets musician gestures to guide harmonic changes, acting as a robotic conductor; and another wherein gestures modulate parameters of Somax2, an AI improvisation agent. The authors underscore flexible, modular design and the importance of intuitive visual communication channels. Prospective future directions include refining the gesture toolkit and collecting data to better understand human-machine co-creativity. The authors’ findings contribute to a broader understanding of machine intelligence in augmenting human creativity, particularly in musical settings.

title: Persistent peripheralization. How adverse conditions affect the scope of policies for regional development in Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
abstract: Abstract Unfavorable economic conditions, demographic decline and institutional constraints all make it difficult for peripheralized regions to implement policies conducive to regional development. This article uses the example of the East German region of Saxony-Anhalt to analyze the ways in which these negative contextual conditions affect the negotiation of ideas in policy design and their implementation by operational stakeholders. Based on expert interviews in the context of current skilled labor recruitment, the study shows that adverse contextual conditions limit the perceived ability of operational stakeholders to act, thus limiting the intended scope of activities. As a result, stakeholders risk further peripheralization for the region. This article contributes to the debate on uneven development by emphasizing the role of individual stakeholders within institutions and the interplay between historical, spatial, and institutional factors in shaping policies.

title: Spatiotemporal Patterns of NPP and Hydrothermal Sensitivity Under Land-Use Change: A Case Study of Guangxi, China
abstract: Amidst the intensifying challenges of global climate change and the increasing demand for regional sustainable development, accurately assessing the contributions and dynamic characteristics of different land-use types to regional carbon sink patterns is essential for understanding ecosystem carbon cycling mechanisms and optimizing carbon management strategies. Based on land-use and Net Primary Productivity (NPP) remote sensing data from 2018 to 2022, this study employs a land-use change coding method and a hydrothermal (temperature and precipitation) sensitivity coefficient approach to analyze the spatiotemporal variation in NPP in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region and its differential responses to hydrothermal conditions. On this basis, sensitivity coefficients were calculated to assess the spatial patterns of NPP sensitivity to temperature and precipitation, revealing spatial sensitivity characteristics and potential ecological risks. The results indicate significant differences in NPP variations among different land-use types, with broadleaf forests, mixed forests, savannas, and croplands identified as the primary contributors to NPP flows. Additionally, the response of NPP to hydrothermal factors exhibits clear spatial heterogeneity: precipitation sensitivity hotspots are mainly concentrated in the northern and southern ecosystems, while temperature sensitivity hotspots are predominantly located in the northern region. Further analysis reveals that the ecosystems in the central and northern regions are more sensitive to temperature changes, whereas coastal areas exhibit higher stability.

title: Survey of consumer expenditure, 2022
abstract: The survey of consumer expenditure provides a detailed picture of Norwegian households yearly consumption of different goods and services. Further it provides insight in the variety of consumption between different types of households, and how the consumption pattern changes over time. Detailed overviews of private households consumption have formed an important foundation for research about income, living conditions and e.g. effects of the tax systems use of direct and indirect taxes. The data can also be utilised for studies of compelementary demand, in economic planning models, or for specification of private consumption in national accounts. The households are classified according to features like household type, income level, occupational status and age, region, sex, total consumption in NOK and more. The number of households in the net sample for 2022 was 3507.The data material is divided into two separate files: an individual level file and a household level file.

title: AR-X Flow: A Mobile-Based Augmented Reality Workspace
abstract: Multi-screen setups improve productivity but require expensive hardware and desk space that many users cannot afford. AR glasses offer virtual displays but cost over $3000. This paper presents AR-X Flow, a mobile AR system that creates virtual monitors using smartphones people already own. The system uses pre-trained YOLOv8 to detect laptops and monitors, positioning virtual screens contextually. Planned features include MediaPipe gesture recognition and WebRTC streaming. This work investigates whether mobile AR can democratize multi-screen workflows without specialized hardware. Our implementation demonstrates successful object detection and mobile-backend communication, though substantial development remains for rendering, gestures, and streaming.

title: Housing the Gap: Provision Structures and Public Policy on Formal Housing Development in Indonesia’s Evolving Market
abstract: Housing shortages remain a persistent global challenge shaped by demographic, economic, and institutional dynamics. In Indonesia, housing demand far outpaces supply: around 800,000 new units are needed annually, yet only about 350,000 are produced by the formal sector, leaving millions dependent on informal solutions. This dissertation examines how the structure of housing provision and public policy interact to shape formal housing development in Indonesia’s evolving market economy. Revisiting Turner’s (1972) concept of housing as a verb and extending it through Adams’s (1994) market-process perspective, the study conceptualizes housing as a dynamic governance process shaped by negotiation, contestation, and adaptation among multiple actors. Through four empirical studies, it analyzes: (1) the transformation of Indonesia’s housing provision structure and the rise of financialization; (2) the evolution of affordable housing policy under public–private interplay; (3) the role of land policies and speculative land banking; and (4) the institutional and market factors driving development delays. The dissertation contributes theoretically by repositioning housing provision as an institutionalized process of governance, and empirically by revealing how speculation, inefficiency, and fragmented regulation reproduce housing gaps. It offers practical insights for strengthening policy integration, land governance, and regulatory capacity toward more inclusive and efficient housing delivery.

title: ANALYSIS OF THE IMPACT OF CHANGES IN TAX POLICY ON STATE BUDGET REVENUES
abstract: Annotatsiya. Ushbu maqolada soliq siyosatidagi o‘zgarishlarning davlat byudjeti daromadlariga ko‘rsatgan ta’siri keng qamrovli va chuqur tahlil qilinadi. Tadqiqot so‘nggi yillarda amalga oshirilgan soliq islohotlari, soliq stavkalari, soliq imtiyozlari tizimi va soliq ma’murchiligining raqamlashtirilishi natijasida byudjet tushumlarining shakllanishi va barqarorligiga qanday ta’sir ko‘rsatganini o‘rganadi. Shuningdek, soliq siyosatining iqtisodiy o‘sish sur’atlari, fiskal barqarorlikni ta’minlash, davlat moliyasini boshqarish samaradorligini oshirish va byudjet tushumlarini optimallashtirishdagi roli tahlil etiladi. Maqolada soliq tushumlarini oshirish, soliqqa tortish bazasini kengaytirish, soya iqtisodiyotini qisqartirish hamda moliyaviy boshqaruvni takomillashtirish bo‘yicha ilmiy-amaliy tavsiyalar ishlab chiqilgan. Natijalar davlat fiskal siyosatini yanada takomillashtirish va iqtisodiy rivojlanishni barqarorlashtirish uchun muhim ahamiyatga ega. Ushbu tadqiqot soliq siyosatining samaradorligini oshirish va byudjet barqarorligini mustahkamlashda nazariy va amaliy yo‘l-yo‘riq sifatida xizmat qiladi. Abstract. This article presents a comprehensive and detailed analysis of the impact of tax policy changes on state budget revenues. The study investigates recent tax reforms, adjustments in tax rates, improvements in incentive systems, and the digitalization of tax administration, and examines how these measures have influenced the formation, growth dynamics, and stability of budget revenues. The research highlights the role of tax policy in promoting economic growth, ensuring fiscal sustainability, and improving public financial management efficiency. It also addresses measures for reducing the shadow economy, expanding the tax base, and optimizing revenue collection. Based on analytical findings, practical recommendations are developed to enhance the effectiveness of fiscal policy, increase state budget revenues, and strengthen economic stability. The results provide both scientific and applied value, offering guidance for future improvements in national fiscal strategies and sustainable economic development. Аннотaция. В статье представлен всесторонний и детальный анализ влияния изменений налоговой политики на доходы государственного бюджета. Исследование охватывает результаты недавних налоговых реформ, корректировку налоговых ставок, совершенствование системы льгот и цифровизацию налогового администрирования, а также их влияние на формирование, динамику роста и устойчивость бюджетных поступлений. Особое внимание уделено роли налоговой политики в стимулировании экономического роста, обеспечении фискальной стабильности и повышении эффективности управления государственными финансами. Анализируются меры по сокращению теневой экономики, расширению налоговой базы и оптимизации процессов сбора доходов. На основе полученных аналитических данных предложены практические рекомендации по улучшению эффективности фискальной политики, увеличению доходов бюджета и укреплению экономической стабильности. Результаты исследования имеют как научное, так и прикладное значение и могут служить ориентиром для дальнейшего совершенствования государственной финансовой стратегии и устойчивого экономического развития.

title: Replication Data for: Contradictory Calculi—Differences in Individuals’ Turnout Decisions across Electoral Systems
abstract: Existing theories of turnout model individuals’ decisions to vote as a function of the utility they would gain from their favored party’s election, the costs of voting, and the intrinsic benefits associated with democratic participation. This project shows that such utility calculations are conditional on electoral rules. In electoral systems with low incentives for strategic behavior, the traditional model of voter turnout is accurate. However, in plurality systems, in which there are stronger incentives for individuals to abandon their true preferences, less importance is placed on the utility associated with the possible success of favored parties.

title: Addressing barriers to innovation by agribusiness to drive growth in South Africa
abstract: This policy brief interrogates trends from a survey of commercial agricultural businesses, including farming, forestry and fisheries enterprises, to inform policy implementation insights. The evidence indicates that resource, knowledge and market factors play a key role in creating an enabling environment for innovation in the agribusiness industry. Therefore, policy interventions that target these factors can support pathways to overcome innovation constraints. On this basis, the policy brief makes a call to the government and policy makers at national, provincial, local and regional levels to develop policies that are responsive to key barriers and may improve innovation performance along the agribusiness value chain.

title: Policy design under research outcome unpredictability: A portfolio-theory model for Japan's research funding
abstract: This study applies portfolio theory to research funding policy under the assumption that research outcomes are inherently unpredictable. Using a mathematical model, we demonstrate that Japan’s “selection and concentration” strategy since 2004 has reduced effective research capacity despite increased headline R&D expenditure. Comparative analysis between 2004 and 2024 shows that expected impact has shrunk to about 40% of the baseline due to reduced research time, weakened operational grants, and unstable career paths. The decline in Japan’s share of Top 10% highly cited papers corroborates the model’s prediction. By integrating theoretical reasoning, empirical evidence, and international comparison, this paper provides a comprehensive proof that portfolio-style baseline funding is the only rational design for sustaining long-term research performance.

title: Statistical analysis of effective COVID-19 government response policies: insights from pre-omicron pandemic data
Consumer Expenditure Survey 2004
abstract: Beginning in 1974, Statistics Norway (SSB) has conducted yearly comsumer expenditure surveys. Pre-1974, nationwide consumer expenditure surveys was carried out in 1958, 1967 og 1973. The main purpose of the surveys has been to give a detailed overview of the expenditures of private households, providing the basis for updates of the weight basus of the consumer price index. Furthermore, the attention has been on maping the consumption and expenditures of different household types. Households are classified by variables such as houshold type (new standard), income, socio-economic status, geographic region and residential area, size of consuption expenditures, etc.The State Administration utilize the data from the Consumer Expenditure Survey in their planning and investigative work. This provides the foundation for decisions and estimates for the years to come. The results from the survey are also used by the National nutrition and physical education council in an ongoing monitoring of the development of the Norwegian diet.The Consumer Expenditure Survey is conducted as a part of the state assignment, and Division for social welfare statistics at Statistics Norway is the responsible unit. Divison for interviews conducts the data collection. There is an energy addition in the Consumer Expenditure Survey 2004, conducted on behalf of the Ministry of Petroleum and Energy.

title: Population Decline Production Function Model: Growth Accounting under Demographic Headwinds
abstract: This preprint introduces the Population Decline Production Function Model, an extension of traditional growth accounting to societies facing demographic headwinds. The model decomposes effective labor into population, participation, employment, hours, voluntary unemployment reduction, and constraint relief (childcare, eldercare, health, assistive technologies). It further integrates capital accumulation, automation limits, household time constraints, and institutional effectiveness through the Institutional Reform Factor (IRF). By embedding task automation and policy levers into a unified framework, the model demonstrates how demographic decline reduces growth unless offset by institutional reform, inclusive participation, managed automation, and constraint relief policies. The framework provides a diagnostic tool for policymakers in aging economies such as Japan. Beyond theoretical formulation, Student’s model enables a dynamic cycle of investment allocation → KPI measurement → auditing → reinvestment, functioning as a ‘policy dashboard’ to sustain growth under demographic decline. This makes it not merely a theoretical construct, but a diagnostic tool directly applicable to policy design and corporate strategy.

title: Managerial competence as a determinant of organizational performance
abstract: Despite the important contribution made by managers to modern economies, little research has been undertaken into the behaviour of managers that is related to organizational performance. Upper level managers (i.e., executives) have been studied least. Consequently, this thesis has created and tested hypotheses on the relationship between managerial behaviour (i.e., competence) and organizational effectiveness at executive level. In addition, the thesis has also created and tested hypotheses on the relationship between managerial competence and individual variables. Directed by Campbell et al's (1970) model of managerial effectiveness, a review was made of the literature on organizational performance, managerial behaviour, environmental and individual variables. Based on this review, a revised model of managerial effectiveness was created from which a model of executive effectiveness in dynamic environments was derived. Eighteen hypotheses were drawn from the latter model for testing in this study. Behavioural and Individual data were collected by means of observation, job analysis interview, biographical Interview, Kirton's Adaption-Innovation Inventory and Ghiselli's Self-Description Inventory from a sample of 30 executives working for an international financial services organization. A short-term and long-term measure of the performance of the units managed by the 30 executives was gathered. A statistically significant, positive relationship was found between eleven "High Performance Managerial Competencies" (HPMC) and the long-term competence/performance of organizational units. Managerial competence was found to be related to three individual factors: Adaption-Innovation, Decision-making Style and Supervisory Ability. Furthermore, results appertaining to environmental variables as well as the development of the HPMC are reported and discussed. A validated model of managerial effectiveness is presented. Finally, the managerial and research implications of the research are discussed.

title: The National Broadcasting System's User Survey, 1983
abstract: Datasettet er hentet fra 'Undersøkelse om radiolytting og fjernsynsseing, 1983', utført av Statistisk sentralbyrå (SSB) etter oppdrag fra Norsk Rikskringkasting (NRK). Undersøkelsen i 1983 var en av SSBs årlige lytter- og seerundersøkelser for NRK. Fra 1967 til 1977 gjennomførte SSB årlige generelle radio- og fjernsynsundersøkelser for NRK. I perioden 1978 til 1985 ble det utført flere spesialundersøkelser, undersøkelser av generell karakter ble bare gjennomført i 1980 og 1983. Fra 1985 tok man i bruk et nytt opplegg med 3 generelle undersøkelser pr. år. Hovedformålet med 1983-undersøkelsen, i likehet med de foregåenede generelle undersøkelsene, var å anslå hvor stor del av landets voksne befolkning som fulgte de enkelte programposter i radio- og fjernsyn i løpet av en bestemt undersøkelsesperiode, og hvordan lytterne og seerne fordelte seg etter bakgrunnskjennetegn som kjønn, alder, utdanning, yrke osv. Opplysniger om hvor mange som har fulgt den enkelte programpost helt eller delvis og hvor mange som har startet eller avbrutt sin radiolytting eller fjernsynsseing i samband med programposten. I tillegg til å registrere oppslutningen om NRKs sendinger tok undersøkelsen sikte på å gi et bilde av befolkningens samlede bruk av massemediene. Det ble tatt med spørsmål om bruken av nye mediatilbud slik som nærradio og video og om etablerte medier som aviser, ukeblad, tidsskrifter, plate- og kassettspillere osv. Undersøkelsen omfatter også spørsmål som gjelder utformingen av programtilbudet, om interesse for forskjellige programtyper, spørsmål om sendetider og om andre saker som har betydning for det praktiske kringkastingsarbeidet. Siden svært mange av spørsmålene også har vært stilt tidligere, gir undersøkelsen muligheter til å studere endringer i bruken av de ulike mediene. For å sikre at registreringen av endringer blir så pålitelig som mulig, er en del av utvalget personer som også var med i Radio- og fjernsynsundersøkelsen januar-februar 1980.Til undersøkelsen ble det i alt utarbeidet 8 skjematyper, én for hver intervjudag Hver skjematype inneholdt spørsmål om programmene for to bestemte programdager (de to siste dagene før intervjudagen). De 8 skjematypene ble delt i to hovedgrupper, A og B. De fleste spørsmålene er de samme i A- og B-skjemaene. I A-skjemaene ble det tatt med noen tilleggsspørsmål om utforming av programposter, i B-skjemaene en del spørsmål om tidsbruken generelt og om interesser i forskjellige emneområder. Skjematype A ble brukt mandag 7., torsdag 10., lørdag 12. og mandag 14. februar; skjematype B ble brukt lørdag 5., tirsdag 8., onsdag 9. og fredag 11. februar.Undersøkelsesperioden var torsdag 3. til søndag 13. februar. Denne filen inneholder data for intervjuene gjennomført mandag 14. februar, spørsmålene gjelder for dagene lørdag 12. og søndag 13. februar.

title: Dataset Evaluasi Efisiensi Website PTS di Pulau Jawa
abstract: Dataset ini berisi hasil pengukuran efisiensi digital dari lima belas website perguruan tinggi swasta (PTS) yang berlokasi di Pulau Jawa. Pengukuran dilakukan sebagai bagian dari penelitian berjudul “Evaluasi Efisiensi Website Perguruan Tinggi Swasta di Pulau Jawa”, dengan tujuan menilai jejak karbon digital, konsumsi energi, ukuran halaman, dan teknologi web yang digunakan oleh setiap institusi. Dataset mencakup beberapa variabel utama yang dikumpulkan menggunakan tiga instrumen: Website Carbon Calculator, Toolsaday Page Size Checker, dan Wappalyzer. Variabel-variabel tersebut mencakup : Emisi CO₂ per kunjungan (gram CO₂) : Estimasi emisi karbon yang dihasilkan setiap kali halaman dimuat. Website Carbon Rating (A+ hingga F) : Klasifikasi efisiensi berdasarkan standar Website Carbon™ Rating System. Konsumsi energi tahunan (kWh) : Perhitungan energi yang dibutuhkan berdasarkan intensitas grid global. Page Size (MB) : Ukuran total halaman, termasuk HTML, CSS, JavaScript, gambar, dan font. HTML Size (KB) : Ukuran dokumen HTML sebagai komponen struktural utama halaman. Green Hosting Status : Informasi penggunaan energi terbarukan oleh penyedia hosting. Teknologi Web (framework, CMS, library) : Output identifikasi Wappalyzer terkait stack teknologi masing-masing website. Kategori Efisiensi (Clean / Dirty) : Klasifikasi berdasarkan rating dan intensitas emisi. Dataset ini dapat digunakan untuk penelitian lanjutan dalam bidang green computing, sustainable web design, analisis performa website, pemantauan emisi digital di sektor pendidikan, dan pengembangan metrik keberlanjutan digital. Selain itu, dataset ini mendukung kajian terkait SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) dan SDG 13 (Climate Action).

title: Desafíos y oportunidades del Emprendimiento Materno
abstract: Resumen: El emprendimiento materno se ha consolidado como un fenómeno socioeconómico relevante en México y América Latina, donde más del 40% de las mujeres emprendedoras son madres. Este grupo enfrenta barreras estructurales como estereotipos de género, limitada disponibilidad de financiamiento y una sobrecarga de trabajo doméstico y de cuidados, factores que afectan la sostenibilidad de sus proyectos. Se realizó una revisión de literatura científica y técnica publicada entre 2019 y 2024, consultando Scopus, Redalyc y Google Scholar. Los estudios se seleccionaron por su pertinencia y se organizaron en dimensiones analíticas. La evidencia muestra que las madres emprendedoras articulan sus identidades de cuidadoras con sus metas profesionales, impulsando modelos de negocio flexibles e innovadores. Además, reinvierten sus ingresos en sus familias y comunidades, fortaleciendo tejido social. El emprendimiento materno combina desafíos estructurales con fortalezas únicas, convirtiéndose en un eje estratégico para el desarrollo económico y la igualdad de género. Abstract: Maternal entrepreneurship has become a significant socioeconomic phenomenon in Mexico and Latin America, where over 40% of women entrepreneurs are mothers. This group faces structural barriers such as gender stereotypes, limited access to financing, and an excessive burden of domestic and care work—factors that affect the sustainability of their projects. A review of scientific and technical literature published between 2019 and 2024 was conducted, consulting Scopus, Redalyc, and Google Scholar. Studies were selected for their relevance and organized into analytical dimensions. The evidence shows that entrepreneurial mothers integrate their identities as caregivers with their professional goals, driving flexible and innovative business models. Furthermore, they reinvest their earnings in their families and communities, strengthening the social fabric. Maternal entrepreneurship combines structural challenges with unique strengths, becoming a strategic driver for economic development and gender equality.

title: ERFOLGREICHE PROFESSIONELLE KOMMUNIKATION IM MODERNEN ARBEITSUMFELD
abstract: Dieser wissenschaftliche Artikel analysiert die Bedeutung professioneller Kommunikation im modernen Arbeitsleben. Es werden grundlegende Kommunikationskompetenzen, Methoden zur Verbesserung der beruflichen Interaktion sowie Strategien für effektive Teamarbeit dargestellt. Darüber hinaus wird erläutert, welche Rolle emotionale Intelligenz, digitale Kommunikation und berufliche Etikette für erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit spielen. Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass professionelle Kommunikation ein entscheidender Faktor für beruflichen Erfolg, Motivation und eine nachhaltige Organisationskultur ist.

title: Peran Umat Beragama dalam Mewujudkan Masyarakat Beradab dan Sejahtera
abstract: Umat beragama menempati posisi strategis dalam upaya mewujudkan masyarakat beradab dan sejahtera. Peran tersebut tampak melalui internalisasi nilai-nilai ketuhanan, moral, dan kemanusiaan ke dalam seluruh aspek kehidupan sosial, mulai dari keluarga, lingkungan bertetangga, hingga institusi pelayanan publik seperti kesehatan dan pendidikan. Agama memberikan kerangka etis yang menumbuhkan sikap saling menghormati, keadilan, empati, dan solidaritas sehingga mampu mengurangi potensi konflik serta memperkuat kohesi sosial di tengah kemajemukan

title: PELATIHAN PENGELOLAAN KEUANGAN BISNIS PELAKU UMKM GUNA MENINGKATKAN LITERASI KEUANGAN
abstract: ABSTRACTThe vital role of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)as a driver of the national economy is frequently accompaniedby serious challenges, particularly those stemming from lowlevels of financial literacy. This issue is clearly observable at thepartner entity, Aneka Kerupuk Fajar Putra, where mostmanagers are homemakers (ibu-ibu rumah tangga). The majorityof business actors in this sector lack the ability to differentiatebetween personal assets and business capital and tend to neglectthe systematic recording of transactions. This study focuses onenhancing the competence and knowledge of these MSMEpartners in the aspect of business financial management. Themethodology implemented is a participatory approach through aseries of interactive training sessions, structured education, andintensive mentoring in basic bookkeeping practices. The successof the activity is measured by assessing the extent of theparticipants’ cognitive understanding improvement. The findingsindicate a substantial jump in financial literacy scores among allparticipants. They now possess a strong comprehension of theimportance of separating cash flow and are capable of applyinga simple financial reporting framework (such as basic incomestatements). It can be concluded that this training interventionproves to be a crucial instrument for improving the financialliteracy of MSME actors, which serves as an essential foundationfor long-term business sustainability.Keywords: Financial Literacy, Business Management, Training,Competency Enhancement, MSMEs

title: Modelo de ventas
abstract: Resumen: El documento aborda el concepto de modelo de ventas como una estrategia estructurada para planificar recursos, prever resultados y guiar acciones comerciales.Se revisan modelos de ventas usados en la práctica profesional, junto con habilidades comerciales y herramientas tecnológicas como CRM y análisis de datos. Los modelos analizados facilitan la prospección, la comunicación de valor y el cierre de ventas. Se identifica que vendedores con empatía, comunicación efectiva y dominio tecnológico obtienen mayores niveles de desempeño.Se concluye que adoptar un modelo de ventas incrementa la eficiencia, fortalece la relación con el cliente y favorece decisiones estratégicas en mercados dinámicos. Abstract: This document addresses the concept of a sales model as a structured strategy for planning resources, forecasting results, and guiding sales actions. It reviews sales models used in professional practice, along with sales skills and technological tools such as CRM and data analytics. The analyzed models facilitate prospecting, value communication, and closing sales. It identifies that salespeople with empathy, effective communication, and technological proficiency achieve higher levels of performance. It concludes that adopting a sales model increases efficiency, strengthens customer relationships, and supports strategic decision-making in dynamic markets.

title: Dataset Audit Kepatuhan Kebijakan Privasi Platform EdTech Indonesia terhadap UU PDP 2025
abstract: Dataset ini berisi data hasil penelitian audit kepatuhan kebijakan privasi sepuluh platform teknologi pendidikan (EdTech) Indonesia terhadap ketentuan Undang-Undang No. 27 Tahun 2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP). Dataset meliputi:- Metadata 10 platform EdTech Indonesia (Ruangguru, Sekolah.mu, Dicoding, Cakap, Pijar Belajar, Pahamify, Kelas Pintar, Kipin School 4.0, Tempat Belajar, Bahaso)- Instrumen audit 19 butir berdasarkan pasal-pasal UU PDP- Skor mentah hasil audit per platform- Matriks kepatuhan agregat per kategori- Analisis kesenjangan industri dengan rekomendasi- Perbandingan kepatuhan berdasarkan status PSE Kominfo Metodologi: Document-based audit dengan pendekatan kuantitatif deskriptifPeriode penelitian: Februari-Maret 2025 Temuan utama:- Rata-rata kepatuhan industri: 65.79% (kategori Sedang)- Platform tertinggi: Ruangguru (97.37%)- Gap utama: masa retensi, prosedur insiden, perlindungan data anak

title: Peran Kebangsaan Muhammadiyah di Indonesia
abstract: Peran kebangsaan Muhammadiyah di Indonesia mencerminkan integrasi mendalam antara komitmen keagamaan dan tanggung jawab sosial-sipil yang telah dikembangkan selama lebih dari satu abad. Khittah Muhammadiyah, terutama yang dirumuskan dalam Muktamar Ujung Pandang 1971, telah memberikan kerangka konseptual yang memungkinkan organisasi untuk menjalankan misi dakwahnya secara inklusif dan memberdayakan, sambil tetap mempertahankan fokus pada kepentingan nasional dan kemajuan bersama

title: Creación de objetivos de ventas
abstract: Resumen: El documento analiza los elementos clave para formular objetivos de ventas orientados al crecimiento, la productividad y la gestión del cliente. Se revisan modelos de embudo comercial, métricas de desempeño y técnicas estadísticas como correlación, regresión y SEM para evaluar eficiencia. Se identifican objetivos centrados en acelerar ventas mediante pedidos, reuniones y actividades CRM, así como metas para incrementar el valor del cliente a través de leads, ventas cruzadas y retención. El caso “Café Verde Tabasco” muestra la utilidad del CPA y el ROMI para determinar canales digitales rentables y optimizar decisiones comerciales. Abstract: This document analyzes the key elements for formulating sales objectives focused on growth, productivity, and customer management. Sales funnel models, performance metrics, and statistical techniques such as correlation, regression, and SEM are reviewed to evaluate efficiency. Objectives are identified that focus on accelerating sales through orders, meetings, and CRM activities, as well as goals to increase customer value through leads, cross-selling, and retention. The "Café Verde Tabasco" case study demonstrates the usefulness of CPA and ROMI for determining profitable digital channels and optimizing business decisions.

Det ble tatt med spørsmål om bruken av nye mediatilbud slik som nærradio og video og om etablerte medier som aviser, ukeblad, tidsskrifter, plate- og kassettspillere osv. Undersøkelsen omfatter også spørsmål som gjelder utformingen av programtilbudet, om interesse for forskjellige programtyper, spørsmål om sendetider og om andre saker som har betydning for det praktiske kringkastingsarbeidet. Siden svært mange av spørsmålene også har vært stilt tidligere, gir undersøkelsen muligheter til å studere endringer i bruken av de ulike mediene. For å sikre at registreringen av endringer blir så pålitelig som mulig, er en del av utvalget personer som også var med i Radio- og fjernsynsundersøkelsen januar-februar 1980.Til undersøkelsen ble det i alt utarbeidet 8 skjematyper, én for hver intervjudag Hver skjematype inneholdt spørsmål om programmene for to bestemte programdager (de to siste dagene før intervjudagen). De 8 skjematypene ble delt i to hovedgrupper, A og B. De fleste spørsmålene er de samme i A- og B-skjemaene. I A-skjemaene ble det tatt med noen tilleggsspørsmål om utforming av programposter, i B-skjemaene en del spørsmål om tidsbruken generelt og om interesser i forskjellige emneområder. Skjematype A ble brukt mandag 7., torsdag 10., lørdag 12. og mandag 14. februar; skjematype B ble brukt lørdag 5., tirsdag 8., onsdag 9. og fredag 11. februar.Undersøkelsesperioden var torsdag 3. til søndag 13. februar. Denne filen inneholder data for intervjuene gjennomført lørdag 12. februar, spørsmålene gjelder for dagene torsdag 10. og fredag 11. februar.

title: DIAGNÓSTICO ESTRATÉGICO E MARKETING DIGITAL EM INDICAÇÕES GEOGRÁFICAS: ANÁLISE DO CONSELHO DO CAFÉ DA MOGIANA DE PINHAL
abstract: As Indicações Geográficas (IGs) representam instrumentos estratégicos para valorização de produtos regionais, porém as organizações gestoras enfrentam desafios relacionados à governança, comunicação e engajamento. Este estudo realizou diagnóstico estratégico do Conselho do Café da Região Mogiana de Pinhal (COCAMPI), organização gestora da Indicação de Procedência obtida em 2016, e avaliou as ações de marketing digital implementadas para fortalecimento da marca territorial. Mediante abordagem de pesquisa-ação, aplicou-se a Matriz SWOT para diagnóstico organizacional, realizou-se pesquisa com produtores e comunidade local, e documentaram-se as estratégias de marketing digital implementadas através de parceria com o Instituto Federal de São Paulo (IFSP). A análise SWOT revelou forças importantes (qualidade do produto, reconhecimento oficial) mas também fragilidades críticas (necessidade de melhorias na presença digital e baixo engajamento). A pesquisa evidenciou que 68% dos respondentes desconheciam a Indicação de Procedência, mesmo oito anos após sua concessão. Em resposta aos desafios identificados, foram implementadas ações de marketing digital incluindo website institucional e presença no Instagram, cujos resultados foram documentados por Ferreira et al. (2025), demonstrando impactos significativos no aumento da visibilidade regional e fortalecimento da identidade territorial. O estudo contribui para compreensão dos desafios de gestão de IGs no Brasil e evidencia o marketing digital como ferramenta essencial para consolidação de marcas territoriais, especialmente em contextos de agricultura familiar.

title: ERFOLGREICHE PROFESSIONELLE KOMMUNIKATION IM MODERNEN ARBEITSUMFELD
abstract: Dieser wissenschaftliche Artikel analysiert die Bedeutung professioneller Kommunikation im modernen Arbeitsleben. Es werden grundlegende Kommunikationskompetenzen, Methoden zur Verbesserung der beruflichen Interaktion sowie Strategien für effektive Teamarbeit dargestellt. Darüber hinaus wird erläutert, welche Rolle emotionale Intelligenz, digitale Kommunikation und berufliche Etikette für erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit spielen. Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass professionelle Kommunikation ein entscheidender Faktor für beruflichen Erfolg, Motivation und eine nachhaltige Organisationskultur ist.

title: Características de la promoción de ventas
abstract: Resumen: El documento analiza las características estratégicas de la promoción de ventas empleadas por fabricantes y detallistas para influir en el comportamiento del consumidor y del distribuidor. Se revisan enfoques teóricos y clasificaciones de herramientas promocionales, tanto monetarias como no monetarias, inmediatas y diferidas. Las promociones al consumidor buscan aumentar el tráfico, detonar compras no planificadas y fortalecer la lealtad; mientras que las dirigidas al distribuidor procuran asegurar exhibición, mejorar posicionamiento y elevar pedidos. Se concluye que la promoción de ventas actúa como instrumento táctico que complementa la comunicación, acelerando decisiones y fortaleciendo relaciones comerciales. Abstract: This document analyzes the strategic characteristics of sales promotions used by manufacturers and retailers to influence consumer and distributor behavior. It reviews theoretical approaches and classifications of promotional tools, both monetary and non-monetary, immediate and delayed. Consumer promotions aim to increase traffic, trigger unplanned purchases, and strengthen loyalty, while distributor promotions seek to secure product display, improve positioning, and increase orders. The document concludes that sales promotion acts as a tactical instrument that complements communication, accelerating decisions and strengthening business relationships.

De 8 skjematypene ble delt i to hovedgrupper, A og B. De fleste spørsmålene er de samme i A- og B-skjemaene. title: Modelo de ventas
abstract: Resumen: El documento aborda el concepto de modelo de ventas como una estrategia estructurada para planificar recursos, prever resultados y guiar acciones comerciales.Se revisan modelos de ventas usados en la práctica profesional, junto con habilidades comerciales y herramientas tecnológicas como CRM y análisis de datos. Los modelos analizados facilitan la prospección, la comunicación de valor y el cierre de ventas. Se identifica que vendedores con empatía, comunicación efectiva y dominio tecnológico obtienen mayores niveles de desempeño.Se concluye que adoptar un modelo de ventas incrementa la eficiencia, fortalece la relación con el cliente y favorece decisiones estratégicas en mercados dinámicos. Abstract: This document addresses the concept of a sales model as a structured strategy for planning resources, forecasting results, and guiding sales actions. It reviews sales models used in professional practice, along with sales skills and technological tools such as CRM and data analytics. The analyzed models facilitate prospecting, value communication, and closing sales. It identifies that salespeople with empathy, effective communication, and technological proficiency achieve higher levels of performance. It concludes that adopting a sales model increases efficiency, strengthens customer relationships, and supports strategic decision-making in dynamic markets.
